facts.statement_en: Systematic review and pairwise meta-analysis of intervention studies.
Adults with imaging-selected acute ischemic stroke, 4.5 to 24 hours after last known well; intravenous tenecteplase versus randomized control treatment; efficacy and safety.
Eligibility is specified in the accepted protocol; final-review methods are identified separately.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: ELIGIBILITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Include randomized controlled trials of imaging-selected adults with acute ischemic stroke treated 4.5 to 24 hours after last known well that compare intravenous tenecteplase with placebo or medical control. Collect the functional, imaging, neurological and safety outcomes specified by the Review using outcome-specific participant counts and denominators.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SELECTION_PROCESS; method_basis: FINAL_REVIEW_METHOD; description: Two reviewers independently screened titles and abstracts and assessed full texts; a third reviewer resolved discrepancies.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: DATA_COLLECTION; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently extract study characteristics, sample size, participant demographics, baseline National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale score, imaging-selection method, occlusion site, tenecteplase dose, treatment window, comparator, protocol-level thrombectomy permissibility, observed thrombectomy use, and eligible efficacy and safety outcomes. When available, outcomes will be extracted separately for thrombectomy-permitted and non-thrombectomy settings. Disagreements will be resolved by a third reviewer. Study authors will not be contacted for additional information.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: RISK_OF_BIAS; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently assess risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2, with a process to resolve disagreements.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: EFFECT_MEASURE; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: The review used risk ratio.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SYNTHESIS_MODEL; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Random-effects meta-analysis will be conducted in R 4.4.2 using the `meta` package. Between-study variance, τ², will be estimated using restricted maximum likelihood, with Q-profile confidence intervals and Hartung-Knapp adjustment for pooled estimates.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: HETEROGENEITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Between-study variance, τ², will be estimated using restricted maximum likelihood, with Q-profile confidence intervals and Hartung-Knapp adjustment for pooled estimates. Heterogeneity will be assessed with Cochran's Q and I²; values around 25%, 50%, and 75% will be interpreted as low, moderate, and substantial heterogeneity.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SUBGROUP; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Differences between subgroups will be tested with chi-square interaction tests and interpreted as exploratory.

In the EVT-stratified exploratory analysis for excellent functional outcome, the non-EVT subgroup RR was 1.26 (95% CI 1.00 to 1.59), the EVT-permitted subgroup RR was 1.25 (95% CI 1.07 to 1.46), and the interaction p value was 0.961.
For good functional outcome, the non-EVT subgroup RR was 1.24 (95% CI 1.03 to 1.49), the EVT-permitted subgroup RR was 1.05 (95% CI 0.90 to 1.22), and the interaction p value was 0.172.
For recanalization, the non-EVT subgroup RR was 2.82 (95% CI 1.69 to 4.70), the EVT-permitted subgroup RR was 1.19 (95% CI 0.89 to 1.60), and the interaction p value was 0.004.
For early neurological improvement, the non-EVT subgroup RR was 2.82 (95% CI 1.69 to 4.70), the EVT-permitted subgroup RR was 0.94 (95% CI 0.58 to 1.53), and the interaction p value was 0.002.
For symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, the non-EVT subgroup RR was 3.82 (95% CI 0.82 to 17.81), the EVT-permitted subgroup RR was 1.57 (95% CI 0.72 to 3.43), and the interaction p value was 0.314.
For 90-day all-cause mortality, the non-EVT subgroup RR was 1.51 (95% CI 0.33 to 7.04), the EVT-permitted subgroup RR was 1.16 (95% CI 0.82 to 1.65), and the interaction p value was 0.72.
